grammar_focus: 复习 KS22/46/70 形容词/副词 + 介词的固定搭配综合(收官包·方案B换情节):interested in、good at、surprised at、fond of、proud of、afraid of、full of、famous for、grateful to…for、curious about、bored with、pleased with、excited about、keen on、worth doing 等固定搭配的辨析
scene: 我姐姐特别喜欢看悬疑小说,也很擅长猜结局。她因为能一天读完一整本书而出名。“我喜欢那种充满意外的故事,”她说。她为自己在最后一页之前就解开谜题而自豪。“别害怕厚厚的书,”她对我说,“要对它们保持好奇。”她读得那么快,我很吃惊。“我很感激作者构思了这么巧妙的情节,”她说。她读书从不厌倦——每一类故事她都喜欢。“一本好书值得读两遍,”她这样认为。现在,我也迫不及待想开始读那本让她爱不释手的书了。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS22/46/70 形容词/副词 + 介词的固定搭配
grammar_card.intro: 很多形容词、副词后面要跟固定的介词,搭配是记住的,不能随便换。本课集中复习:①+ in / at——interested in(对……感兴趣)、good at(擅长)、surprised at(对……感到惊讶);②+ of——fond of(喜爱)、proud of(为……自豪)、afraid of(害怕)、full of(充满);③+ for / to——famous for(因……出名)、grateful to sb for sth(因某事感激某人);④+ about / with / on——curious about(对……好奇)、bored with(厌倦)、pleased with(对……满意)、excited about(对……兴奋)、keen on(热衷于);⑤worth + doing(值得做)。

rows: interested in books / good at guessing / surprised at how fast
fond of stories / proud of herself / afraid of / full of
famous for reading fast / grateful to the author for the plot
curious about / bored with / pleased with / keen on
A good book is worth reading twice.

specialRules.rule: 美语“数学”说 math(英式 maths);“假期”说 vacation(英式 holiday)。本课已按美语写。
形容词后的介词是固定搭配:interested in、good at、fond of、famous for、grateful to…for、keen on、curious about、pleased with;worth 后接动名词(worth reading)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is the sister interested in?

passage: My sister is really interested in mystery novels and good at guessing the ending. She is famous for finishing a whole book in one day. "I'm fond of stories that are full of surprises," she says. She was proud of herself for solving the puzzle before the last page. "Don't be afraid of long books," she tells me. "Be curious about them." I was surprised at how quickly she read. "I'm grateful to the author for such a clever plot," she said. She is never bored with reading — she is keen on every kind of story. "A good book is worth reading twice," she believes. Now I'm excited about starting the one she is so pleased with.
